pairing.rule: Both arms receive identical digest-frozen subjects, findings, snapshot commits, stored architecture evidence, deterministic index identity, context ceiling, and terminal observation contract.
pairing.unique_issue_identity: A separately frozen stable issue-group identity is used for matched yield; neither arm may define or alter it.
pairing.outcome_blinding: Outcomes remain unavailable until both arms have terminal predictions, abstentions, validation chronology, and authoritative or explicitly unknown usage.

fixed_metrics: provider input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens
fail_closed_rules: Any arm with incomplete terminal observations blocks comparison.
Missing provider usage remains unknown and blocks token- or cost-based comparison; it is never assigned zero.
Unsupported pricing remains unavailable and blocks cost-based comparison.
Verifier unsupported or incomplete states remain abstentions and cannot be counted as validated issues.
Cohort or subgroup insufficiency remains explicit and cannot be repaired after outcomes are visible.
No pooled improvement can override a pre-frozen weak-subgroup safety failure.
No threshold, margin, cohort, subgroup floor, resampling plan, or decision rule is selected by this protocol-only foundation.
qualification_preconditions: one later exact qualification receipt with cohort, metrics, decision rules, provider, token, cost, time, and data ceilings
post_qualification_rule: Production activation remains prohibited unless G03b and empirical recall safety pass under the later frozen qualification and every other gate remains documented-pass.
